headline: Recommended purchase of Muni-Link billing system for $92,621 annual cost and $78,000 one-time fee; denied two water bill adjustments.
summary: The meeting covered a billing system purchase and two bill adjustment requests. The billing system purchase was recommended to the Purchasing Board. Both bill adjustment requests were denied.
decisions: Recommended that the Purchasing Board authorize purchase and installation of the Muni-Link billing system, 4-0.
Denied the request to waive the $200 termination/reconnection charge at 57 Rosemont Ave, Pawtucket, 4-0.
Denied the bill adjustment request for 52 Manton St, Pawtucket, 4-0.

plain_text:
PAWTUCKET WATER SUPPLY BOARD 
 
The 447th meeting of the Pawtucket Water Supply Board met on October 13th, 2026 at 5:00 PM  
William Masuck called the meeting to order at 5:00 PM. 
 
PWSB Members Present 
William Masuck, Chairperson – present   
James Bradford, Vice Chairperson – present 
Robert Benson – present 
Roberto Moreno – present  
Mark Theroux – not present 
Jeannine Bourski – not present 
 
PWSB Staff Present 
James DeCelles - Chief Engineer 
Russell Houde – Assistant Chief Engineer 
Katie Peters – Executive Project Manager 
Christopher Collins – Source Water Manager  
Joe Keough - Attorney 
 
 
Public Attendees 
None 
 
4.  Consent Agenda 
 
 
Brief discussion about the continued wholesaling of water to Cumberland and the potential for an 
interconnection with Lincoln. 
 
A motion to approve the Consent Agenda was made by James Bradford and seconded by Roberto 
Moreno.
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes  
James Bradford – Yes 
Roberto Moreno – Yes  
APPROVED 
 
5A. Billing System Purchase 
PWSB recommended that the Pawtucket Purchasing Board authorize the purchase and 
installation of the Muni-Link billing system under the HGAC cooperative purchasing agreement. 
The annual cost of the system will be $92,621 and the implementation/data conversion will be a 
one-time fee of $78,000. 
The installation of Muni-Link would also bring our billing software to cloud based solution that 
is hosted, monitored, updated, and patched by Neptune. We would have a state-of-the-art billing 
system that was designed for the sole purpose of utility billing and no longer be reliant on 
outdated software with outdated hardware and operating system that only a few people know 
how to operate and maintain. 
A motion to recommend that the Purchasing Board authorize the purchase and installation of the 
Muni-Link utility billing system was made by Robert Benson and seconded by James Bradford. 
 
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes  
James Bradford – Yes 
Roberto Moreno – Yes  
APPROVED 
 
5B.a. Billing Adjustment Request - 57 Rosemont Ave, Pawtucket 
The customer, Mr. Matthew Guertin, is requesting the $200 termination/reconnection charge be 
waived. He believes he was not properly notified of the pending termination. Mr. Guertin's meter 
was due to be updated. After several letters, and a door tag, on August 19, 2026, the service was 
terminated. The customer's tenant called and the meter was updated and service restored later that
afternoon. 
 
Based upon a review of the facts and in accordance with PWSB policy it is recommended not to 
grant the adjustment to this account. 
 
Motion to deny the bill adjustment was made by James Bradford and seconded by Roberto Moreno. 
 
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes  
James Bradford – Yes 
Roberto Moreno – Yes  
APPROVED 
 
5B.b. Bill Adjustment Request – 52 Manton St, Pawtucket 
The customer, Mr. Helio Pereira, is looking for relief from his water bill. He is hoping for some 
relief from a high-water bill. There was abnormal consumption for the months of July, August and 
September at their rental property. A running toilet was probably the problem. Consumption for 
October is back to normal. 
 
Based upon a review of the facts and in accordance with PWSB policy it is recommended not to 
grant the adjustment to this account. 
 
Motion to deny the bill adjustment was made by James Bradford and seconded by Robert Benson. 
 
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes  
James Bradford – Yes 
Roberto Moreno – Yes  
APPROVED 
 
Next scheduled meeting is November 10th, 2026. 
A motion to adjourn was made by James Bradford and seconded by Robert Benson. 
Meeting adjourned at 5:18 pm.
Certified by PAWTUCKET WATER SUPPLY BOARD, recorded by kp 
 
 
 
 
 
William Masuck, Chairperson
